items.title: Overnight whereabouts resolved: detained trio brought to Parliament Street PS ~3 AM; SEM production at Mandir Marg expected — outcome still unreported
items.summary: CJP legal head Ratna Singh's overnight X posts (livemint; corroborated by thedailyjagran and Latestly) resolve the 'destination unknown' open question: Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka and Ajinkya Shinde were brought to Parliament Street Police Station at ~3 AM IST Oct 14 in a private van, after the ~2:30 AM move out of Jaffarpur Kalan PS; they were held nearly 24 hours without lawyer access or stated grounds. Singh's 5:38 AM IST update said the trio are likely to be produced before the Special Executive Magistrate (SEM) at Mandir Marg Police Station within an hour (due ~6:30-7:00 AM IST); the production outcome is still unreported as of this run. Delhi Police's position remains 'preventive arrest' (ANI); Singh calls the arrests illegal and says Tihar judicial custody is possible.
items.source_name: livemint (HT Media); corroborated by thedailyjagran (Jagran Prakashan) and Latestly — all citing CJP legal head Ratna Singh's X posts
